sections.kicker: Prepared for Georgina Ramezzana by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new client would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Georgina says she makes value evident. Her own site does not yet say what her value is.
sections.keep: Your line, "Construyo marcas que despiertan deseo." It is a clear promise to a client.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The headline is a promise every brand designer makes.
pins.why: Clients compare you with every studio that also says it makes value visible.
pins.how: Say whose value you make evident, and how your way differs.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: Prospects pick on price because the headline gives them nothing else.

pins.quote: Branding, estrategia de marca y dirección creativa.
pins.what: Three services listed as a menu.
pins.why: Branding, strategy and direction is what most studios list; a menu does not show your point of view.
pins.how: Lead with the one result clients hire you for.
pins.label: Your services
pins.cost: You read as one more option in a long list.

pins.what: Hospitality is hidden in the navigation.
pins.why: A clear specialty is the fastest reason to choose one designer over another.
pins.how: Consider making hospitality the front of the brand.
pins.label: Your niche
pins.cost: Your strongest niche is invisible to the clients who would pay for it.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at your studio, and you said something is off but you could not name it, even after a new website. I spent time on the site. Three things stood out.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Georgina Ramezzana's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
